name: Hlomla Moosa Magopeni
title: Full-Stack Developer
bio: Application Development student at CPUT building real-world full-stack solutions — from ride-hailing kiosks to student marketplaces — using Java, JavaScript, PHP, and MySQL.
aboutBio: I'm Hlomla Moosa Magopeni, a 3rd-year Diploma in ICT Application Development student at CPUT. I build full-stack applications that solve real community problems — from helping people request rides safely without a smartphone, to streamlining clinic bookings for students on campus. I work across the full stack: designing front-end interfaces, writing back-end logic, and integrating relational databases. I'm currently completing my Work Integrated Learning placement as a Full-Stack Developer at AAG (Achievement Awards Group), where I've picked up PHP, Docker-based local development, and security-minded practices — patching real vulnerabilities and upgrading platforms onto supported runtime versions. I thrive in agile teams, take quality seriously, and write code that's clean and maintainable.
